note: The Hobie 16's rebuild (docs/hobie16-2 on). Slice 1 builds the two hulls only, as one object so the loop measures her overall beam; slice 2 adds the platform, slice 3 the rudders, slices 4 and 5 the rig and sails, slice 6 the hardware. Rules as in sections_j22.json: an entry ending in '_' or '*' is a name prefix, any other an exact name; unmatched is 'other'.
joins_note: No joins yet: slice 2 lists the crossbars' castings on the hulls' decks.
